# Kyle Scott Law

> Kyle Scott Law is a personal injury law firm in Tustin, California (Orange County), led by trial attorney Kyle J. Scott, admitted to the State Bar of California in 1991. The firm represents people injured in car, truck, motorcycle, rideshare (Uber and Lyft), and pedestrian accidents, falls on unsafe property, dog bites, medical malpractice, elder abuse and neglect, traumatic brain injury, sexual abuse and harassment, school and institutional negligence, and wrongful death, in Orange County and throughout California. Consultations are free, in English or Spanish, and there is no fee unless there is a recovery. Website content is general information and is not legal advice.

## Facts

- Name: Kyle Scott Law (also written KJS Law)
- Lead attorney: Kyle J. Scott, founder and trial attorney. B.A., UCLA, 1986; J.D., Loyola Law School, 1991. State Bar of California number 155434, admitted 1991; admitted to the United States District Courts for the Central and Southern Districts of California. In practice since 1991; his own firm since 2003.
- Office: 17671 Irvine Blvd., Suite 210, Tustin, CA 92780 (Orange County, California)
- Telephone: +1-714-544-1460 (toll-free +1-866-757-0959; fax +1-714-544-1463)
- Email: Team@kjslaw.com
- Hours: Monday to Friday, 8:30 AM to 5:00 PM, Pacific time
- Languages: English and Spanish; the whole website is also published in Spanish at https://kjslaw.com/es
- Fees: free consultation; no fee unless there is a recovery
- Area served: all of Orange County, including Tustin, Santa Ana, Anaheim, Irvine, Orange, Costa Mesa, Huntington Beach, Garden Grove, Fullerton, and Newport Beach, and cases throughout California
- Published results include $6.8M (school negligence), $6M (abuse case), and $5.75M (brain injury); more than $50 million recovered in published verdicts and settlements. Prior results do not guarantee a similar outcome.
- Canonical website: https://kjslaw.com/
- Profiles: https://apps.calbar.ca.gov/attorney/Licensee/Detail/155434 · https://www.avvo.com/attorneys/92780-ca-kyle-scott-225782.html · https://lawyers.justia.com/lawyer/kyle-joseph-scott-1503298

## En español

> Kyle Scott Law es un bufete de lesiones personales en Tustin, California (Condado de Orange), dirigido por el abogado litigante Kyle J. Scott, admitido al Colegio de Abogados de California en 1991. Representa a personas lesionadas en accidentes de auto, camión, motocicleta, Uber y Lyft y atropellos, caídas, mordeduras de perro, negligencia médica, abuso de personas mayores, lesiones cerebrales, abuso sexual, negligencia escolar y muerte injusta. Se atiende en español. Consulta gratuita; sin honorarios a menos que haya una recuperación. Sitio en español: https://kjslaw.com/es
